integrity: Proved graph classification with a finite direct checker for n=3 through 11; computation does not replace proof; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Result is confined to four named colours, open-neighbourhood PCF and one-vertex recolouring on simple wheels; no extra-colour or Kempe connectivity is asserted. Scalar chromatic number is not new. Historical priority is provisional pending broader literature verification.
title: A sharp freezing threshold for optimal proper conflict-free wheel recolouring
